function read(this: Ref): Ref
  requires isSubtype(typeOf(this), GaugeModel())
  requires acc(footprint(this), wildcard)
  ensures isSubtype(typeOf(result), intType())


method con() returns (v_ret_0: Ref)
  ensures isSubtype(typeOf(v_ret_0), IndirectGauge())
  ensures isSubtype(typeOf(v_ret_0), IndirectGauge()) &&
    isSubtype(typeOf(v_ret_0), DefaultGauge())
{

  fold acc(DefaultGauge_unique(v_ret_0), write)
  fold acc(IndirectGauge_unique(v_ret_0), write)
  label lbl_ret_0
  unfold acc(IndirectGauge_unique(v_ret_0), write)
  unfold acc(DefaultGauge_unique(v_ret_0), write)
